summary: Quota day-chart buttons are named by their day and carry the full per-series evidence as a mounted accessible description. The native title that duplicated the custom hover readout is removed; the heatmap calendar, drawer and table titles are unchanged.

schema.detail: No persisted or wire schema change.

compatibility.detail: Day-chart button accessible names change from the full evidence sentence to the day label; the same sentence is now the accessible description. Selection, hover and focus readout behavior is unchanged.
